title: Loves MBz
description: Exposes the MusicBrainz IDs MediaMonkey keeps in its database but never shows: Albums.MBGID (release), Albums.MBRGGID (release group) and Artists.MBGID (artist). Adds three read-only tracklist columns, a dialog that lists, copies and can set those IDs, and a Track Properties tab that links and edits per-track MusicBrainz extended tags, including adding missing tags and group editing of tags shared by the selected tracks.
author: NiZDesign
